discovery.selection: Deliberate: test bounded causal adaptation of the native transformer's distribution before final bit mixing, with an explicit wrong-truth control.
alternatives: Forge-cmix public source offers a distinct eligible-parent audit, but its published architecture alone supplies no new Gamma mechanism or measured improvement. Source inspection may continue; no build or corpus launch selected.
Exact-residual model packing already completed with a 23-byte model saving erased by its external restorer. Do not repeat that realization.
Select residual-ratio calibration for a synthetic causal and inverse test before any native integration.
discovery.prior_negative: NNCP output-bias-only midpoint adaptation lost 1604 archive bytes. This candidate does not inherit MIDAS gains: it uses bounded integer observed/expected counts on a separate fixed predictor, not midpoint gradient updates. No evidence yet shows this correction helps FX2.

hypothesis: A bounded observed-to-expected symbol ratio can correct persistent marginal miscalibration while preserving exact decoder-rebuilt state. Synthetic success only establishes implementation feasibility; native final archives must establish benefit.

configuration.alphabet: 2..256 symbols; ordered positive integer base counts, each <=65535
configuration.normalization: Expected counts use floor(p_i * 65536 / sum(p)), distributing the remaining units by descending remainder, ties by ascending symbol id.
configuration.ratio: (prior + observed_i) / (prior + expected_i), clipped to [1/4,4]; floor(base_i * clipped ratio), minimum 1. No floating-point prediction arithmetic.
configuration.update: Predict before truth. Add one Q16 count to decoded symbol; add normalized base probabilities to expected counts. After every 256 updates halve both histories by floor division.

arms.K: Train identical histories but emit unchanged base counts
arms.D: Emit corrected counts and train from decoded truth
arms.S: Same correction trained from (decoded symbol + 1) modulo alphabet size

configuration.state: Serialize all future-affecting history, position, arm, alphabet, and pending base/output counts. Validate before restore; reject duplicate predict or observe before predict.

acceptance: Reuse lib/predictor.py arithmetic fixture, not a new entropy coder. P/K payload identity; all four arms independently invert and repeat on synthetic raw bytes.
Compare every pre-truth probability and full state boundary, including decay. Future suffix changes cannot affect earlier predictions.
Roundtrip pending and nonpending checkpoints; reject invalid counts, impossible positions, oversized state and malformed histories.
Retain archive sizes, parameter/state size, source inventory and process costs. Synthetic archive gains receive no corpus or package qualification credit.
next_gate: Only after synthetic correctness, freeze one separately identified native FX2 P/K/D/S fixture with unchanged trained model, vocabulary and frontend, complete probability/state traces, package delta and resource admission. Do not tune on reserved corpus populations.
